data.gender_notes: Tammiel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Tammiel means 'God is my consolation.' This biblical name comes from the Hebrew words 'etam' (my God) and 'yachal' (comfort). It was an ancient name for a high priest or angel. In Christian tradition, Tammiel is also associated with the archangel Raphael. The name Tammiel carries the meaning “God is my consolation” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Tammiel usually hope their child will grow to embody god is my consolation and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tammiel total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
